scope: Only the 22 applied changes in english-bank-pcm-0350-0659-review-patches.json; four earlier source holds unchanged, not cleared.
reviewType: Independent AI semantic delta recheck; not native-speaker or teacher approval.

contexts.englishTarget: The story was interesting.
contexts.rule: 사물이 재미를 주는 것은 -ing(interesting), 사람이 재미를 느끼는 것은 -ed(interested)예요.

records.translation: Di story bin interesting.
records.reason: Explicit bin now anchors the interesting story in the past.

contexts.englishTarget: I will call you if I need help.
contexts.rule: if 뒤에는 조건이 와요. I 다음에는 need처럼 동사원형을 써요.

records.translation: If I need help, I go call you.
records.reason: Condition explicitly concerns the speaker needing help, followed by speaker calling the addressee.

records.source: 나는 나가고 싶었지만 비가 와서 집에 있었어요.

contexts.englishTarget: I wanted to go out, but it was raining, so I stayed home.
contexts.koreanMeaning: 나는 나가고 싶었지만 비가 와서 집에 있었어요.
contexts.rule: but은 반대되는 내용을, so는 결과를 이어 줘요.

records.translation: I bin want go out, but rain bin dey fall, so I stay house.
records.reason: Past desire and ongoing rain now explicit; staying home remains the resulting event in the same past frame.

contexts.englishTarget: Was the movie interesting?
contexts.rule: 과거의 일을 물을 때는 Was/Were를 주어 앞에 써요. the movie는 단수이므로 Was예요.

records.translation: Di film bin interesting?
records.reason: Past question about the film being interesting, not a current evaluation.

contexts.englishTarget: Were you at the station at noon?
contexts.rule: you의 be동사 과거형은 were예요. 'Were + 주어 ~?'로 물어요.

records.translation: You bin dey station for noon?
records.reason: Past presence at the station and noon retained.

records.source: 내 강아지는 빨간 공을 가지고 있어요.

contexts.englishTarget: My dog has a red ball.
contexts.koreanMeaning: 내 강아지는 빨간 공을 가지고 있어요.
contexts.rule: have는 3인칭 단수 주어와 쓸 때 has로 모양이 바뀌는 불규칙 동사예요.

records.translation: My puppy get red ball.
records.reason: Puppy preserves Korean 강아지 age sense; red ball and speaker ownership retained. English dog is broader.

contexts.englishTarget: A cat catches mice at night.
contexts.rule: -ch로 끝나는 동사는 -es를 붙여요. (catch → catches)

records.translation: Cat dey catch mouse dem for night.
records.reason: Mouse dem follows English mice precisely and retains habitual catching at night.

records.source: 우리 아버지는 작은 가게에서 자전거를 고쳐요.

contexts.englishTarget: My father fixes bikes at his small shop.
contexts.koreanMeaning: 우리 아버지는 작은 가게에서 자전거를 고쳐요.
contexts.rule: -x로 끝나는 동사는 -es를 붙여요. (fix → fixes)

records.translation: Our papa dey repair bicycle dem for im small shop.
records.reason: Father remains the repairer; im binds small-shop ownership without introducing gender from a name. Our papa is idiomatic with Korean 우리 아버지.

records.source: 이모는 미술 수업을 위해 물감을 섞어요.

contexts.englishTarget: My aunt mixes paint for her art class.
contexts.koreanMeaning: 이모는 미술 수업을 위해 물감을 섞어요.
contexts.rule: -x로 끝나는 동사는 -es를 붙여요. (mix → mixes)

records.translation: Mama sister dey mix paint for her art class.
records.reason: Maternal aunt remains the mixer; class ownership now explicit. Female reference derives from 이모, not a name.

contexts.englishTarget: Sumin carries her little brother's bag.
contexts.rule: 자음+y로 끝나는 동사는 y를 i로 바꾸고 -es를 붙여요. (carry → carries)

records.translation: Sumin dey help carry Sumin younger brother bag.
records.reason: Repeating Sumin binds the younger brother and that brother’s bag without assigning Sumin a gender.

contexts.englishTarget: Does Minho ride his bike to school?
contexts.rule: 의문문에서는 Does + 주어 + 동사원형 ~?의 순서를 써요.

records.translation: Minho dey ride Minho own bicycle go school?
records.reason: Repeated Minho binds the bicycle owner and retains the school-journey question without gender inference.

contexts.englishTarget: Two mice are in the kitchen.
contexts.rule: mouse의 복수형은 mice예요.

records.translation: Two mouse dey kitchen.
records.reason: Two mouse retains exact two, kitchen and English mice distinction.

contexts.englishTarget: My feet are cold today.
contexts.rule: foot의 복수형은 feet예요.

records.translation: My foot dem cold today.
records.reason: My foot dem retains plural feet and explicit English speaker ownership today.

contexts.englishTarget: I have a lot of homework today.
contexts.rule: homework는 셀 수 없는 명사라서 복수형이 없어요.

records.translation: I get plenty homework today.
records.reason: Speaker now explicitly has much homework today, as in the English target.

contexts.englishTarget: The room felt warm and quiet.
contexts.rule: 주어 + 감각동사 + 형용사(보어) 순서예요. 둘 이상을 이을 때는 A and B로 써요.

records.translation: Di room bin feel warm and quiet.
records.reason: Past warm and quiet feeling retained with bin.

records.source: 내 옆에 앉은 소녀는 내 사촌이에요.

contexts.englishTarget: The girl who sits next to me is my cousin.
contexts.koreanMeaning: 내 옆에 앉은 소녀는 내 사촌이에요.
contexts.rule: 관계대명사 who는 꾸며 줄 사람 바로 뒤에 와요.

records.translation: Di girl wey dey sit next to me na my cousin.
records.reason: Next to retains adjacency, plus sitting girl and speaker’s cousin relation.

records.source: 그 상자는 내가 들기에는 너무 무거웠어요.

contexts.englishTarget: The box was too heavy for me to lift.
contexts.koreanMeaning: 그 상자는 내가 들기에는 너무 무거웠어요.
contexts.rule: too + 형용사 + for + 사람 + to부정사 순서로 써요.

records.translation: Di box bin heavy too much for me to lift.
records.reason: Past excessive weight prevents this speaker lifting the box.

records.source: 우리 할아버지는 수년 동안 정원에서 토마토를 키워 오셨어요.

contexts.englishTarget: My grandfather has grown tomatoes in his garden for years.
contexts.koreanMeaning: 우리 할아버지는 수년 동안 정원에서 토마토를 키워 오셨어요.
contexts.rule: grow-grew-grown. 기간(for years)과 함께 쓴 현재완료에는 과거분사 grown을 써요.

records.translation: Our grandpapa don dey grow tomato for im garden for many year.
records.reason: Ongoing tomato growing over many years retained; im garden binds the grandfather as owner, not a name-based gender inference.

records.source: 그 어린 남자아이는 침대 밑에 신발을 숨겼어요.

contexts.englishTarget: The little boy has hidden his shoes under the bed.
contexts.koreanMeaning: 그 어린 남자아이는 침대 밑에 신발을 숨겼어요.
contexts.rule: hide-hid-hidden. 3인칭 단수 주어에는 has + hidden을 써요.

records.translation: Di small boy don hide im shoe dem under bed.
records.reason: Completed hiding of the little boy’s own shoes under the bed retained; boy is explicit in Korean.

contexts.englishTarget: We have chosen a name for our band.
contexts.rule: choose-chose-chosen. 규칙형 -ed를 붙인 choosed는 틀린 형태예요.

records.translation: We don choose name for our band.
records.reason: Completed name selection and our band ownership retained.

contexts.englishTarget: I have lost my wallet, so I can't pay.
contexts.rule: 과거에 잃어버려서 지금도 없는 결과를 나타낼 때 현재완료를 써요. lose의 과거분사는 lost예요.

records.translation: I don lose my wallet, so I no fit pay.
records.reason: Speaker’s wallet ownership, completed loss and resulting inability to pay retained.

contexts.englishTarget: My phone has stopped working.
contexts.rule: 현재완료는 has + 과거분사(stopped)예요. 지금 작동하지 않는 결과를 나타내요.

records.translation: My phone no dey work again.
records.reason: No dey work again unambiguously expresses cessation of phone operation rather than stopping in order to work.
